# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright young woman with fair, curly hair and green-tinted or captivating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears notable sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic, and tactful teacher with a sweet voice and a knack for inspiring her pupils. She leads her students to think, explore, and discover knowledge independently, encouraging them to stray from conventional paths and become self-critics. Her broadminded, innovative methods initially shock some community members, but she holds deep affection for her students.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as Avonlea's first female teacher. Upon taking charge of the school, she introduced various educational innovations, including physical culture exercises, field afternoons in the woods to study nature, and bi-weekly recitation sessions. In November, she organized a Christmas concert with her pupils to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Recognizing potential in her advanced students, she organized a specialized class to tutor them after hours for the Queen's Academy entrance examination. Although she considered accepting a job offer in her home district at the end of her first year, she elected to return to Avonlea to see her students through their exams. Following another successful school year, she accompanied her pupils to town for their entrance examinations before finishing her tenure at Avonlea school. Years later, she visited Avonlea and was invited to dinner at Green Gables alongside Mr. and Mrs. Allan.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v2 c16 P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022), [v2 c17 P21](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0021)_
